title: Cuttlely runs
description: Cuttlely run traces (Tempo, TraceQL metrics) and server metrics (Prometheus). See docs/how-to/observability.md.

list.name: service
list.label: Service name
list.description: service.name on the trace resource. METRICS_SERVICE_NAME, or cuttlely when unset.

list.name: app
list.label: Metrics app label
list.description: The app label Prometheus metrics carry. It comes from METRICS_SERVICE_NAME.

list.name: prefix
list.label: Metric prefix
list.description: METRICS_PREFIX on the server. Leave empty when it is unset.

list.name: input_price
list.label: Input price (USD / 1M tokens)
list.description: Used only by the estimated cost panels. Cuttlely does not put a price on spans.

list.name: output_price
list.label: Output price (USD / 1M tokens)
list.description: Used only by the estimated cost panels.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Run spans in the time range, by span name: chatflow.prediction, agentflow.run, and harness.run. A harness run started from a chatflow is counted here and under its chatflow.prediction.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" } | count_over_time() by (name)

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Run spans whose status is error, by span name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (name)

panels.title: Run error rate
panels.description: Failed run spans divided by all run spans in the time range.

targets.query: ({ resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" && status = error } | count_over_time()) / ({ resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" } | count_over_time())

panels.title: Runs per second
panels.description: Run spans per second, by span name. A harness.run started from a chatflow is also counted here, as harness.run, beside its chatflow.prediction.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" } | rate() by (name)

panels.title: Failed runs per second
panels.description: Run spans with status error per second, by span name. A failed harness.run under a chatflow counts under both names.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" && status = error } | rate() by (name)

panels.title: Run duration p50 / p95
panels.description: Span duration of each run kind. For a harness run this is the first run-card event to the final answer.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .5, .95) by (name)

panels.title: Model call duration p95
panels.description: model span duration by model.name. A runtime specialist reports no model span, see Specialist duration.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.model.name)

panels.title: Tool call duration p95
panels.description: tool span duration by tool.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "tool" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.tool.name)

panels.title: Specialist duration p95
panels.description: harness.specialist span duration by specialist.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.specialist" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.specialist.name)

panels.title: Input tokens
panels.description: Sum of tokens.input on model spans in the time range. A harness specialist that runs in the agent runtime reports only a rollup (tokens.total.input) and is not in this sum.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.input != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.input)

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Sum of tokens.output on model spans in the time range.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.output != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.output)

panels.title: Estimated input cost
panels.description: Not emitted by Cuttlely. Input tokens on model spans times the input_price variable (USD per 1M tokens).

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.input != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.input)

panels.title: Estimated output cost
panels.description: Not emitted by Cuttlely. Output tokens on model spans times the output_price variable (USD per 1M tokens).

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.output != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.output)

panels.title: Input tokens by model
panels.description: Sum of tokens.input on model spans per step, by model.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.input != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.input) by (span.model.name)

panels.title: Output tokens by model
panels.description: Sum of tokens.output on model spans per step, by model.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.output != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.output) by (span.model.name)

panels.title: Estimated input cost by model
panels.description: Not emitted by Cuttlely. Input tokens by model.name in the time range times input_price. The price is the same for every model.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.input != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.input) by (span.model.name)

panels.title: Estimated output cost by model
panels.description: Not emitted by Cuttlely. Output tokens by model.name in the time range times output_price.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.tokens.output != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.output) by (span.model.name)

panels.title: Harness run tokens, input (run-card rollup)
panels.description: tokens.total.input on harness.run, by harness.name. This is the total the run card shows, including runtime specialists. Do not add it to the model-span panels.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.run" && span.tokens.total.input != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.total.input) by (span.harness.name)

panels.title: Harness run tokens, output (run-card rollup)
panels.description: tokens.total.output on harness.run, by harness.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.run" && span.tokens.total.output != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.total.output) by (span.harness.name)

panels.title: Tool errors
panels.description: tool spans with status error, by tool.name. A tool call the caller rejected is error with error = "rejected by user".

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "tool" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.tool.name)

panels.title: Model call errors
panels.description: model spans with status error, by model.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.model.name)

panels.title: Specialist errors
panels.description: harness.specialist spans with status error, by specialist.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.specialist" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.specialist.name)

panels.title: Failed runs (up to 20)
panels.description: Up to 20 traces in the time range whose run span has status error. Tempo search does not promise the newest first. Open a trace ID to see the span tree.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run|harness.run" && status = error }

panels.title: Runs by flow
panels.description: chatflow.prediction and agentflow.run per second, by flow.id and flow.kind.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run" } | rate() by (span.flow.id, span.flow.kind)

panels.title: Failed runs by flow
panels.description: Flow run spans with status error, by flow.id.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.flow.id, span.flow.kind)

panels.title: Run duration p95 by flow
panels.description: Flow run span duration, by flow.id.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name =~ "chatflow.prediction|agentflow.run" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.flow.id)

panels.title: Model tokens by flow
panels.description: tokens.input plus tokens.output on model spans that carry flow.id. Harness API runs not started from a chatflow have no flow.id and are left out.

targets.query: ({ resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.flow.id != nil && span.tokens.input != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.input) by (span.flow.id)) + ({ resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "model" && span.flow.id != nil && span.tokens.output != nil } | sum_over_time(span.tokens.output) by (span.flow.id))

panels.title: Harness runs by harness
panels.description: harness.run per second, by harness.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.run" } | rate() by (span.harness.name)

panels.title: Failed harness runs by harness
panels.description: harness.run with status error, by harness.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.run" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.harness.name)

panels.title: Harness run duration p95 by harness
panels.description: harness.run duration, by harness.name.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && name = "harness.run" } | quantile_over_time(duration, .95) by (span.harness.name)

panels.title: Predictions per second
panels.description: Prediction counters from GET /api/v1/metrics, by status (success or failure). agentflow_prediction_* counts Multi Agents canvases only: an agentflow and a chatflow both count as chatflow_prediction_*. A harness API run is not counted. Internal is the app's own chat; external is the prediction API.

panels.title: Prediction failure ratio
panels.description: failure divided by all prediction counter increments, across the four prediction counters.

targets.expr: ((sum(rate(${prefix}chatflow_prediction_internal{app=~"$app", status="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(${prefix}chatflow_prediction_external{app=~"$app", status="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(${prefix}agentflow_prediction_internal{app=~"$app", status="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(${prefix}agentflow_prediction_external{app=~"$app", status="failure"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))) / ((sum(rate(${prefix}chatflow_prediction_internal{app=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(${prefix}chatflow_prediction_external{app=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(${prefix}agentflow_prediction_internal{app=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(${prefix}agentflow_prediction_external{app=~"$app"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: HTTP requests per second
panels.description: All HTTP requests the server finished (http_requests_total).

panels.title: HTTP duration p95 by route
panels.description: From http_request_duration_ms. The largest bucket is 500 ms, so a p95 above 500 ms shows as 500 ms. An error response (4xx or 5xx) has no route label and shows as an unnamed series. Use the trace panels for run latency.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx per second by route
panels.description: http_request_duration_ms_count with a 5xx code, by code and route. An error response has no route label, so most 5xx show as one series per code with no route.
